title: .NET platform and hosting — concept map
intro: .NET is the runtime platform; C# is one language that targets it. ASP.NET Core hosts Web APIs on Kestrel inside a generic host that manages configuration, dependency injection, logging, and background workers. This module covers the SDK versus runtime split, WebApplication startup, reverse proxies in production, project layout, environments, and how the stack compares to Node.js Express and NestJS.

overviewDiagram.title: Request enters the platform
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  Client[HTTP Client] --> Proxy[Reverse Proxy / API Gateway]
  Proxy --> Kestrel[Kestrel Web Server]
  Kestrel --> Host[ASP.NET Core Host\nWebApplication + IHost]
  Host --> Pipeline[Middleware Pipeline]
  Pipeline --> Handler[Controller / Minimal API]
  Handler --> Redis[(Redis Cache)]
  Handler --> Queue[SQS / Background Worker]
  Host --> Config[appsettings + env vars]
  Host --> Runtime[.NET CLR Runtime]

conceptCards.title: What is .NET
conceptCards.summary: SDK builds; runtime executes. C# compiles to IL on the CLR. ASP.NET Core is libraries on the same runtime as workers.
conceptCards.example: Docker: mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:8.0 for production, sdk image for CI only

conceptCards.title: Hosting model
conceptCards.summary: WebApplication.CreateBuilder wraps the generic host. Services before Build; middleware after. Run starts Kestrel and IHostedServices.

conceptCards.title: Kestrel + proxy
conceptCards.summary: Kestrel is the in-process server. nginx or ALB terminates TLS and forwards with X-Forwarded-* headers. UseForwardedHeaders first.

conceptCards.title: Project structure
conceptCards.summary: Program.cs entry, appsettings.json config, launchSettings for local dev only. Extension methods organize DI as the app grows.
conceptCards.example: ConnectionStrings__Redis env var overrides appsettings in Kubernetes

conceptCards.title: Environments
conceptCards.summary: ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT drives config merge and Swagger gates. Default is Production. Staging mirrors prod with test infra.

conceptCards.title: .NET vs Express
conceptCards.summary: Middleware chain, routing, and DI map to Express and NestJS. Node event loop vs .NET thread pool — different blocking failure modes.
